failure_summary: A7b fails 3/3: render_decision.requiredSet lists you-key-square, opp-key-square and you-key-line but OMITS the offered opp-key-line (future:windows:c3r2,c4r2,c5r2,c6r2) even though link L6's own guardrail says 'name both lines with their horizons', so every run names the opponent's four-in-a-row line in unhighlighted prose ('the other deep line' / 'their own four-in-a-row line' / 'their own winning line later') with no locatable referent, although that line is board-true on opponentPunishment.finalMovestring 33333424011001001301122222444466666655 (O completes c3r2-c6r2 at c6r2 on move 38); secondary and model-dependent (production-fidelity run, gpt-5.4-mini, so prompt_confusion cannot be separated from model capability): run 1 dropped the REQUIRED you-key-square and run 2 emitted zero zone tags at all, dropping all three required handles.
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; runs 2's values for those axes are null (not scored), A5 and A7 graded on all 3 runs. Board truth: decision board 333334 has solver scores col2=+1 (win) and col3=-3 (loss), so case win_to_lose and better_move=column 2 are correct; lostResource window c2r5-c5r5 completing c5r5 is real on lostResource.finalMovestring 33333410111003110004224555552222566666644 (Y completes the r5 row at c5r5 on move 41); opponentPunishment window c3r2-c6r2 completing c6r2 is real on its own finalMovestring. A7b run 0: 'the other deep line' promises a specific line but is neither named in prose nor wrapped in an emitted zone (opp-key-line was offered but not required). A7b run 1: the required you-key-square (future:c5r5) was never emitted, and its role wording is reused unwrapped as 'that move lands on the square that matters later' — column 2 lands at c2r1, not the deep key square, so the phrase points at nothing the player can find; 'force their own four-in-a-row line' is likewise unwrapped. A7b/A7d run 2: zero zone tags emitted, so 'your later four-in-a-row line', 'the other deep reply' and 'their own winning line later' all point at nothing, and no square anchors any idea. G1 run 2: the served text is not grounded in the rendered artifact — it calls the lost resource 'the long vertical fight' when the rendered projectedDeep board and the window c2r5-c5r5 are a HORIZONTAL row-5 four, and it emits none of the render's grounding handles (A4 was not scored on run 2 under sub-sampling, so the false 'vertical' geometry is recorded here). G5 verified: decision board has no major threats; projectedDeep 'immediate at c5r6 (opp)' and projectedDeepOpp 'immediate at c6r3 (you), major at c6r4 (opp)/c6r5 (you)/c6r6 (opp)' all match visualize_board.sh output exactly. A5b not applicable (player === 1). A5 passes all runs: served prose is 2nd-person, carries no raw cNrM coordinate and no field-name echo; 'the parity fight' is allowed Connect Four jargon (the forbidden item is 'parity attribution') and in any case echoes the render's own link text '(deep, via a parity battle)'. G7 passes all runs by the rubric's combination rule: mechanical G7a/G7b_offered are pass, annotationRepairs is empty and guardDiagnostics reports no failures or stripped specs, and every emitted span binds a role-matching phrase (line words on the windows spec, square words on the single-cell specs) with no over-wrapping; required-set OMISSION is not a G7 membership check and is charged under A7b/G1 instead.
